criteria.text: The bridge forwards permission.asked and permission.replied with the exact shared WebSocket payload.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c1: forwards asked and replied with the exact permission WS payload

criteria.text: GET /agent-sessions/:id/pending-permissions proxies the engine using the session directory and returns only that engine session's asks.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c2: GET proxies the engine in the session directory and filters by SDK session

criteria.text: POST /agent-sessions/:id/permissions/:permissionID/reply proxies the engine with the persisted directory and SDK session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c3: POST replies with the persisted directory and SDK session

criteria.text: An unmatched reply returns 404 and does not clear the pending client state.
criteria.test_id: issue-1340-c4: POST returns 404 and preserves pending state when the engine matches nothing
